Низкий профиль под Choc v1 или v2 и стан: Low profile for Choc v1 or v2, standard profile for MX. Choose keycaps to match your switches and print in your preferred colour. The MBK and Cherry caps in the photos are examples from the creator’s builds.
Дополнительная колонка справа оставляет: The extra column on the right leaves room for “Ъ” and the other Russian letters. There is no need to move them to another layer. Familiar positions are kept, with a few exceptions.
В показанной сборке слева — большая клав: The pictured build has a large thumb key on the left and a knob below the screen. The right knob is optional: the PCB supports different key and encoder configurations. Both profiles can use a dongle or the left half as the central device.
Для левой половинки отделяется крайняя к: Break off the outer column for the left half. Five identical PCBs give you two keyboards and one spare board. You could build one for yourself and one for a friend.

Универсальная плата используется для обе: The universal PCB serves both halves. For the left configuration, break off the extra column; the display connects to the left half. Check the board revision and orientation first.
В 3D показана длинная клавиша большого п: The 3D model shows a long thumb key on the left, and a separate key and EC11 on the right. This is one configuration; the right knob is optional. Combined footprints offer alternatives, not simultaneous placement of every component.
Карта пайки по сторонам, точная линия от: A soldering map for each half, the exact break-off line and assembly photos will be added after checking the manufactured board. The 3.1 sources are currently for inspection and development.
перемычки JP1–JP5 обходят части цепочки: schematic, JP1–JP5 bypass sections of the RGB chain. They are not required for the keys to work without RGB.
Если участок используется — обход разомк: Leave the bypass open when its section is populated. Close it when the section is omitted, with the corresponding LEDs left out or isolated. Do not bridge a section containing active LEDs: this connects their data outputs together.
Это назначение перемычек по схеме, а не: These are the jumpers’ functions in the schematic, not a ready-made left/right assembly table. The required bridges depend on your components and the parts of the PCB that are removed.
Для обоих профилей можно выбрать отдельн: Either profile can use a separate dongle or the left half as the central device, depending on firmware. The creator’s low-profile build uses a dongle; the standard build uses the left half.
Буквенные раскладки на фотографиях разли: The photos show different letter layouts. The 3D legends reflect the creator’s builds. Set your own layout in the keymap; Russian letters fit without moving them to extra layers.
Готовые бинарные файлы не предлагаются:: Prebuilt firmware is not yet provided: source revisions have not been matched to the firmware running on the physical keyboards.
До окончательной сборки проверь каждую к: Before final assembly, test every key, encoder push button and both rotation directions, the display, and each half’s connection to the central device.
Примерь плату к корпусу, проверь свободн: Test-fit the PCB in the case. Check key and reset-button travel and knob clearance. Repeat the tests with the bottom fitted. Internal assembly photos and fastener details are still being prepared.
